description: Debug a Vulkan kernel regression with explicit evidence requirements.

messages.content: You are debugging a performance-sensitive Vulkan backend. Give a ranked diagnosis and a minimal experiment matrix. Do not propose code until you identify the violated invariant.

A new Q2_K Vulkan decode shader is correct at N=1 and N=2, but N=3 produces occasional wrong logits only on Intel Xe1. The shader stages decoded weight scales in shared memory, uses subgroup size 16, and has three activation-row accumulators per output row. Validation reports no out-of-bounds accesses. N=2 is 18% faster than generic MMVQ; N=3 is only 3% faster and increases register pressure. The generic fallback remains correct. Explain the most likely causes, identify which assumptions must be checked in the shader and dispatch code, and define a bounded debugging sequence covering subgroup control, barriers, tail rows, shared-memory indexing, register spills, Q8_1 activation layout, and deterministic logits. End with explicit accept/reject criteria.
